name: io.github.kadeep-ai/kadeep
title: KaDeep
description: AI QA for coding agents: test any URL (localhost too) in a real browser, WCAG audits, CI gate.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Anthropic key for test_url. Optional: without it, start_trial gives a free KaDeep trial.

environmentVariables.name: KADEEP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: KaDeep access token (optional; `kadeep login` or start_trial also work).

environmentVariables.name: KADEEP_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default KaDeep project id or name for the cloud project tools.
